title: helmia convolvulacea
intro: Helmia convolvulacea, commonly known as Helianthus convolvulacea, is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family. It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of various health conditions. The health benefits of Helmia convolvulacea include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which help to soothe skin irritations and infections, while also providing relief from fever and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and triterpenoids, which exert therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective effects.
